description: This file defines the DatabaseConfigurationController class within the OrangeHRM installer, specifically for the upgrade process. It setups and renders the database information screen in the installer workflow.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering the database configuration screen during the upgrade process in the installer.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by setting up the database info screen component and updating the current installer screen state.
